title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 116 Main Street in Dansville, New York, as the "Staff Sergeant Alexandria Gleason-Morrow Post Office Building".
official_summary: Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 116 Main Street in Dansville, New York, as the "Staff Sergeant Alexandria Gleason-Morrow Post Office Building."

summary.headline: Names a post office building in Dansville, New York, after Staff Sergeant Alexandria Gleason-Morrow.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 116 Main Street in Dansville, New York. The building will now be called the Staff Sergeant Alexandria Gleason-Morrow Post Office Building. It does not change how the post office runs or any mail service.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was signed on December 21, 2018.
